description: This file contains C++ class methods implementing operations for managing atomic heap messages within the libwebsockets library, including starting an atomic message, retrieving data, and appending new data.

classes.name: lssAc
classes.description: Class managing atomic heap messages for secure streams within the libwebsockets context.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes or consolidates the atomic heap message, creating a single linear buffer if multiple fragments exist.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the current buffer segment from the atomic heap message.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends data to the atomic heap message buffer.
